s.t:
Our Social Media Manager, reporting to the Marketing Director, will be a key member of the marketing team and the driving force behind Degy's digital presence. We're looking for a mid-level professional who is forward-thinking, trend-savvy, and passionate about the live entertainment space.

This role is strategy-forward, responsible for setting the vision, roadmap, and execution plans for how Degy shows up across social platforms to grow our audience, engage fans, and amplify our artists and events.

You'll develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies, create and activate campaigns, and produce company-centric content that tells compelling stories. The Social Media Manager will also design and implement data-driven campaigns, track and report on analytics, and make recommendations based on insights to improve performance.

While strategic leadership is the core focus, you'll also roll up your sleeves with caption writing, creative ideation, and occasional hands-on content production (Adobe Suite or Canva). Consistency across all platforms and adaptability to new trends and tools will be key to telling Degy's story effectively.
Opportunities for bonuses based on performance

Qualification into the company's 401k program after required time served
Qualification into the company's pension program after required time served
Paid Time Off (PTO) including vacation and company holidays
General work expenses covered (wifi, computer, travel, supplies)
Optional cell phone plan offered through company phone plan

s.h: Duties will include (but are not limited to)
s.t:
Strategy & Leadership
Develop and own Degy's comprehensive social media strategy, aligning it with brand and business goals.
Define KPIs and reporting standards to evaluate performance and impact on sales.
Make data-driven decisions to improve quality, engagement, and use of communication channels.
Stay current on industry updates, entertainment trends, and new platform features.
Lead with a positive, solutions-focused attitude in a fast-paced environment
Content & Campaign Management
Manage all social media channels across Degy and affiliated companies.
Conceptualize, curate, and create robust and unique posts that meet defined objectives.
Create, update, and manage weekly and monthly content calendars.
Write, curate, and edit copy and scripts with strong storytelling and brand alignment.
Collaborate closely with the marketing and creative teams to execute strategy and campaigns.
Partner with designers, video editors, or external creators to develop visuals, graphics, Reels, and TikToks.
Maintain consistent and regular engagement across all platforms — posting content, monitoring, and replying to comments and messages.
Ensure a consistent brand voice across all posts, campaigns, and platforms.
Analytics & Insights
Pull and analyze performance data using platform-native insights and tools (e.g. Pardot/Salesforce, Agorapulse, Meta Biz Suite, Google Analytics).
Provide regular reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with actionable recommendations.
Track content against KPIs and A/B test formats, captions, schedules, and creative.
Make recommendations based on analytics to refine campaigns and further marketing strategy.
Community & Engagement
Monitor and engage with followers through comments, DMs, and mentions to foster relationships.
Establish and manage relationships with influencers, content creators, partners, and Degy roster artists.
Alert Marketing Director and leadership of any online concerns or issues requiring attention.
Respond to sensitive or crisis scenarios in coordination with leadership/PR.
Trends & Paid Media
Create and implement paid social media strategies tailored for each platform.
Manage budgets for boosted posts, paid campaigns, and content tools.
Stay ahead of algorithm changes, entertainment trends, and cultural movements.
Cross-Team Collaboration & Marketing Integration
Partner with the Marketing and Creative Directors to integrate social into larger campaigns.
Support related marketing strategies involving Degy's website, app, ticketing, sponsorship activations, and live events.
Educate internal stakeholders on best practices and new platform features.
Participate in broader company initiatives across Degy's family of entertainment businesses.

Occasionally oversee interns, SkillBridge associates, or other assigned support staff.
Handle off-hours requests as needed for events, live activations, or urgent issues.
Perform other duties as assigned to support Degy's marketing and entertainment initiatives.

We're seeking a mid-level Social Media Manager with at least 3 years of professional experience and a proven track record of managing effective social media platforms. The ideal candidate is hands-on, confident, and outgoing, while also being analytical, organized, process-oriented, and an excellent communicator.
You should bring strong storytelling and copywriting skills, combined with the ability to grow audiences, drive engagement, and run successful campaigns across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. Proficiency in Canva and CapCut is required, with experience in Adobe Creative Suite a plus.

Familiarity with analytics and platform management tools such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and TikTok Business Manager is necessary, and experience with social media management tools is required, with Agorapulse experience a plus. Experience managing paid social budgets and ad campaigns is a plus.
Experience with Office 365 and SharePoint is required, and familiarity with project management software, specifically ClickUp, is a plus.
The ideal candidate is capable of managing multiple projects and shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. This role requires adaptability, a willingness to jump in from day one, and the ability to thrive in a remote work setting. Occasional travel to events, conferences, and meetings may be required, along with flexibility to work some nights, weekends, and holidays to support live entertainment.
Must be a United States Citizen and reside in the United States.

About Aion
Aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernising internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
We work differently than most AI companies: our teams deploy alongside our customers, turning production-ready AI into real business outcomes in weeks, not quarters.
We're a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI and we're looking for exceptional people to help us scale.

We're looking for an AI-native content operator to lead aion's social media presence, thought leadership, and content strategy across LinkedIn, X, and other relevant channels.
This is not a traditional social media role. You'll work directly with company leadership to identify important developments across AI, enterprise technology, startups, and venture capital, then turn those insights into content, commentary, and narratives that grow aion's brand and influence.

Work closely with design to create social graphics, carousels, videos, and visual content

To qualify for a Web Content and Social Media Specialist your resume and supporting documentation must support: A. Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position and is directly in or related to this position.

To qualify at the GS-11 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-09 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military, or private sector.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement. Creditable specialized experience includes: Developing and managing website and social media content. Creating graphic animation and video content for web distribution.

Using website analytics to assess user access patterns. Implementing strategies to increase website traffic and audience engagement. B. Education Substitution: Such education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work.

Education must be from a college or university accredited by an organization approved by the U.S. Department of Education. See http://ope.ed.gov/accreditation/Search.aspx. If using education to meet basic qualifications, YOU MUST SUBMIT A TRANSCRIPT as supplemental documentation.

To qualify based on education in lieu of specialized experience, you must possess: a Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or, three (3) full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.M. if related. C.

Combination: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for grade level GS-11 and may be computed by first determining the applicant's total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the applicant's education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages.

The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify an applicant for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grade GS-11.

To be found well-qualified as an ICTAP applicant, individuals need to demonstrate experience including: developing innovative/creative content in response to customer requests or internally generated requirements; identifies target audience and determines best designs for websites; ensures content is appropriate for public distribution; Uses website analytic and diagnostic programs/tools to assess user access patterns and provide improvement recommendations.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

As a Social Media Manager, you will play a critical role in building and managing the organic social and content engine for a growing direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand. You'll take ownership of content pillars, editorial direction, content calendars, copywriting, community engagement, and the production process across multiple social channels.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution. You'll be expected to bring your own point of view, make thoughtful editorial decisions, and develop distinct voices across multiple accounts while remaining aligned with the broader brand direction.
You'll also be working within a sensitive health category, where credibility, empathy, cultural awareness, and clinical accuracy are essential. This means knowing how to communicate complex topics in a clear and consumer-friendly way, while understanding when content requires additional review or when a conversation should be escalated.
Accountability
Your success as the Social Media Manager will be defined by your ability to build a consistent, engaging organic presence while creating a scalable content operation that keeps production moving efficiently.

s.h: Here's how you'll make an impact
s.t:
Content Strategy & Editorial Direction
Define and maintain clear content pillars for organic social channels.
Establish editorial direction across multiple brand and personal accounts.
Develop distinct tones and content approaches for each account.
Build and maintain a structured content calendar and publishing cadence.
Balance educational, trust-building, culturally relevant, and brand-led content.
Bring an independent point of view on content opportunities while remaining aligned with the broader brand vision.
Organic Social Media
Own day-to-day organic execution across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Maintain a consistent and relevant social presence across channels.
Identify opportunities to participate in conversations and cultural moments related to women's health, hair loss, beauty, and wellness.
Adapt content appropriately across channels rather than relying on identical cross-posting.
Continuously identify new formats, topics, and content opportunities that strengthen organic presence.
Copywriting & Content Development
Personally write strong, channel-appropriate marketing copy.
Develop captions, video scripts, social copy, and longer-form written content.
Translate complex or clinical topics into clear, empathetic, consumer-friendly language.
Maintain credibility without allowing content to become overly clinical or impersonal.
Ensure content is thoughtful and relevant to audiences navigating sensitive health concerns.
SEO & AEO Collaboration
Partner with external SEO and AEO specialists on blog, website, and answer-engine content.
Understand SEO and AEO fundamentals well enough to collaborate effectively with specialist partners.
Support briefs and written content informed by organic search priorities.
Ensure SEO and AEO recommendations remain consistent with brand voice and content requirements.
Coordinate content requirements between external partners and internal stakeholders.
Community Management & Engagement
Own day-to-day community engagement across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Monitor and respond appropriately to comments and direct messages.
Build authentic relationships with the audience.
Identify recurring customer questions, concerns, and themes that can inform future content.
Exercise strong judgment when responding to sensitive health conversations.
Escalate clinical or high-risk questions where appropriate rather than providing unsupported medical guidance.
Content Accuracy & Approval
Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure health-related content is reviewed before publication.
Establish a lightweight and dependable approval process.
Balance accuracy with the need to maintain content velocity.
Ensure claims and educational content are appropriately validated.
Prevent the approval process from becoming an unnecessary bottleneck while maintaining required quality standards.
Content Production & Workflow Management
Brief marketing operations, video-editing, and other creative resources on content requirements.
Coordinate content production from idea through approval and publication.
Maintain visibility across content status, deadlines, dependencies, and approvals.
Ensure contributors have clear briefs and expectations.
Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the production process.
Keep the content engine moving without requiring constant founder or leadership involvement in individual deliverables.
AI-Enabled Content Operations
Use tools such as Claude and ChatGPT for ideation, research, drafting, repurposing, and editing.
Develop efficient AI-assisted workflows for recurring content tasks.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive parts of the content production process.
Use AI to increase output without compromising empathy, originality, or accuracy.
Independently review and improve AI-generated content before publication.
Collaborate with future AI-enabled compliance and content-auditing workflows.
AI should function as a productivity multiplier , not as a substitute for strong writing and editorial judgment.
Colleagues
You'll work closely with founders, clinical stakeholders, marketing operations, video production resources, external SEO/AEO partners, and other cross-functional contributors. You'll act as the operational owner of the organic content engine, ensuring that ideas move efficiently from strategy through production, approval, and publication.
At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As the Social Media Manager , your vertical focus will be on organic social strategy, content development, and editorial direction, while your horizontal focus will include community management, SEO/AEO collaboration, content operations, AI-enabled workflows, and brand communication.

Software never stops changing. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Why Deliveroo
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, and looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners.

With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design, we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Social Media - France to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of Deliveroo’s French social presence. You’ll shape how Deliveroo shows up across social channels, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, platform-native, creatively ambitious and connected to our wider marketing and business strategy.
Sitting within our Global Brand Marketing function and reporting to the Director, Social, Cultural and Earned Media, you’ll work closely with our France Marketing team, agency partners and colleagues across Brand, Media, Integrated Marketing, Consumer Communications, Commercial, Grocery and Retail.
This role is open to applicants based in France or England and follows a hybrid working model, with three days a week in either our Paris or London HQ .
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining our Social, Culture and Earned Media team, connecting people with Deliveroo through the moments, partnerships and experiences that matter most. You’ll balance strategic ownership with hands-on leadership, setting the long-term direction for social in France while ensuring our day-to-day presence is timely, engaging and effective.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Set the direction for social in France , leading our strategy and roadmap across always-on activity, brand campaigns, commercial priorities, cultural moments and reactive opportunities, with a focus on building brand equity, consideration and cultural relevance.
Turn global thinking into locally relevant work , translating brand and campaign strategies into social-first ideas, formats and executions that resonate with French audiences and feel native to each platform.
Lead our French social presence , overseeing channels including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, as well as the content calendar, tone of voice and community engagement approach.
Bring teams and partners together , acting as the senior social lead for France and collaborating across local Marketing, Brand, Media, Commercial, PR, Global and European Social teams to embed social early in campaign planning and share learnings across markets.
Lead creative delivery and partnerships , managing agency partners and influencer activity from briefing and production through approvals and launch, ensuring work meets the right creative, strategic and operational standards.
Keep Deliveroo connected to culture , monitoring French culture, creators, communities, trends, platform behaviours and competitors to identify credible opportunities for Deliveroo to join or lead conversations.
Turn performance into progress , establishing effective ways of working, reporting on social performance and community insights, and using those learnings to optimise content, campaigns and channel strategy. You’ll also coach junior team members and contribute to raising social standards across markets.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Deep social and cultural expertise , with strong knowledge of major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, alongside an excellent understanding of French culture, internet behaviour, creators, communities and trends.
Flawless written French and excellent English communication skills , with the judgement to develop distinctive, accurate and culturally relevant brand communications.
Strong strategic and creative judgement , with experience developing social strategies and campaigns that build brand visibility, engagement and cultural relevance, from initial strategy and briefing through execution, optimisation and reporting.
A data-informed approach , with a strong understanding of social metrics and the ability to translate performance and community insights into clear recommendations that improve future work.
Strong leadership and collaboration skills , with experience managing agency partners, creative development, stakeholders and competing priorities, alongside the ability to coach junior colleagues, influence effectively and operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

s.h: Was wir dir bieten - Unsere Benefits
s.t:
Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig . Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
yfood hält dich fit. Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
Weg vom Fleck. Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven. Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen. Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are . Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.
